 About the match
 On this page you can find the SL Benfica vs Gil Vicente match lineup for Portugal League Cup — Quarter Final, on Thursday 29-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. SL Benfica lines up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Lenglet, while Gil Vicente sets up in a 3-4-3 led by Buatu. SL Benfica is led by head coach Marco Silva, while Gil Vicente is managed by Luís Pinto. The match is played at Estadio da Luz.
